smoke_gate.expansion_rule: Expand to the frozen eight-environment pilot only if runtime and receipt checks pass, at least one target environment passes locality, and the candidate is not redundant with linear self_rollout_horizon_recovery on all locality-admitted target comparisons.

selection_rationale: The r27 work order requests self_rollout_horizon_recovery_curvature for the remaining self-forcing coverage gap.

The predecessor applies a linear history-age schedule and was redundant with uniform teacher recovery; the successor applies a convex quadratic schedule and therefore isolates acceleration of recoverable exposure error rather than its mean or slope.
The first conditioned latent, current noisy latent, input actions, checkpoint, evaluator, seeds, teacher reference, and symmetric dose frame remain unchanged.
Probe selection uses the frozen work order and algebraic non-equivalence only; no target-local primitive benefit label is used.
post_collection_rule: If the smoke gate admits expansion, collect the remaining six environments under the same campaign, build the atlas, replace only self_forcing_finetune's required path in a cumulative affinity, and rerun the unchanged selector plan, effect-label index, transfer certificate, and collision labels.
claim_boundary: This stage tests whether quadratic history-age recovery supplies a nonredundant local diagnostic direction. It is not model-improvement evidence and cannot by itself establish selector superiority or transfer safety.
